items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Carney Wainwright was the guitar player. And I was the pianist, of course.

ctx.x: trombone player, he had been formerly with Earl Hines, and I really can't remember his name. Maybe I'll think of it later.

But anyway, in the rhythm section was Tommy Potter on bass. The guitarist... The only guy that I know that could create almost exactly like Freddie Greene... Carney Wainwright was the guitar player. And I was the pianist, of course.

And during the wartime situation, all musicians were hard to find. We were fortunate to get these people. We had hoped to have either Max Roach or Shadow Wilson with the band, but somebody had scooped both of them up. I think Max Roach was with Benny Carter at that particular time, and I don't know exactly what Shadow was doing. I know a little later he was with the Basie band. I don't know whether he was with Basie or not when the band started. But I know he wasn't available. I think he might have been in the…
